pages.text: Quantum Network Bridges can extend a $(l:ae2_mechanics/me_network_connections)network$(/l) over infinite distances and even between dimensions. They can carry 32 channels in total (regardless of how cables are connected to each face), essentially acting like a wireless $(l:items_blocks_machines/cables#dense-cable)dense cable$(/l).
$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()
Of note, $(bold)both sides must be chunkloaded$() so a $(l:items_blocks_machines/spatial_anchor)Spatial Anchor$(/l) or other chunkloader must be used if the 2 sides are far apart.

Eight of these blocks placed around a $(item)ME Quantum Link Chamber$() will create a Quantum Network Bridge. Only the 4 $(item)ME Quantum Ring$() blocks adjacent to the $(item)ME Quantum Link Chamber$() will accept network connections, the 4 corner blocks cannot connect to cables.

One of these blocks surrounded by a $(item)ME Quantum Ring$() will create a Quantum Network Bridge.
